limitations: The 16 mm motor shaft follows the selected product specification; the original 22 mm manufacturer STEP remains a separate conflicting variant, not a resolved physical measurement.
Purchased-part GLBs preserve native geometry scale. Simplified physics envelopes and nominal fasteners are not manufacturing models.
The chassis is constrained to a level plane with force-based traction; independent wheel suspension, tipping and motor electrical dynamics are not modeled.
Lift and gate are ideal position-actuated joints. Their collision contacts do not qualify actuator force, compliance, link strength or hardware safety.
The destination/source rails are proposed fixtures. Organizer-field runs are not official scoring, tire-hardware or competition qualification.
Open-gate contact is reported separately from load-bearing fork/tray support; release still requires destination support, low height and persistence.
No purchases, received-part measurements, fabrication, owner-reviewed visual approval or physical robot tests are claimed.
